text:
maria: Heads up — CI microbench on PR #13137 triggered a perf threshold fail on the kvcache microbench. See CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/3888/artifact/perf.log :sob:

maria: From the CI artifact:
```text
microbench_kv_cache: baseline p90=82.3ms  PR p90=104.5ms  delta +27%
per-token cost baseline=0.0021 PR=0.0028
kv_hit_rate baseline=0.962 PR=0.851
```

liam: Ugh, that's pretty big. Any obvious diffs in the PR? files changed: kernel_autoselect.py, batcher/prefetch.py, kvcache/eviction_policy.py

maria: The PR modified kernel scoring to prefer matmul-vectorized kernels when seq>4096 and updated prefetch window from 128->64.

sophia: Could the lower prefetch be causing more KV cache misses? kv_hit_rate drop suggests eviction increase.

dmitri: I can run a quick bisect. @perf-bot did the CI job include compile flags? maybe it fell back to scalar kernels.

perf-bot: RegressionDetector: PR 13137 failed microbench threshold (p90 +27%). Linked failure: https://ci.redwood.internal/3888

liam: Repro locally with docker:
```
./scripts/run_microbench.sh --profile=kvcache --model=redwood/open-8k --seq=8192 --batch=1
```

maria: repro confirms. On my machine toggling back prefetch to 128 brings p90 to ~85ms. So prefetch change is suspect.

sophia: But kernel_autoselect change also targets seq>4096. Maybe the scoring push favored a kernel with worse KV locality (different register use). Let's run perf counters.

dmitri: Doing perf counters now — will post results in 20m.

liam: Suggestion: revert prefetch delta in PR and run CI before bisect. If that fixes, we can iterate on kernel scoring separately.

maria: I've pushed a quick revert commit to the branch (c3f9a2b) and queued CI. If green, we can merge revert and rework heuristic.

perf-bot: CI job queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/3889 -> job id 3890

dmitri: Perf summary: on PR (before revert) we saw L2 miss rate +3.4%, KV miss events doubled during warmup window. Kernel ops/cycle also dropped ~8% for the selected kernel.

sophia: Interesting — that matches lower prefetch causing earlier evictions during warmup, cascading to lower KV hits.

liam: If revert CI is green, assign to maria for follow-up to tune prefetch heuristics and add a microbench that measures kv_eviction_rate.

maria: Revert CI passed. I'll open a follow-up change with small prefetch rollback and add regression test.

sophia: Also add a golden config in the kernel selector for seq>4096 to prefer the fused attention variant unless autotune shows better throughput with similar eviction stats.

dmitri: Logged bisect notes: suspected commits range 9a2b..f1e3; but revert narrowed to prefetch change. Closing bisect for now.

liam: Thanks all. Filing a note on the PR and marking as rollout-blocked until the follow-up lands. :thumbsup:
